commands.reason: Protection detects the physical N03 fault and isolates every incident LV path.
Restore healthy downstream buses through the alternate radial path after isolation.

metadata.paper_case: physical three-phase N03 fault, SDN isolation, and tie restoration

scenario.name: Physical fault with SDN restoration
scenario.description: A native PSCAD ABC-to-ground fault starts at N03 at 4.8 s. The controller isolates N03 at 5.0 s, the fault logic clears at 5.2 s, and the alternate N02-N05-N06-N04 path closes at 6.0 s.
